Description.Name: Kincaid
Description.Details: Michael Kincaid was born into a family that had long been loyal to ComStar, since at least sometime during the First Succession War.  As such service to the Order was expected and he joined as soon as he was able.  Long brought up on the stories of his family’s storied past as Mechwarriors loyal to the Star League he found himself drawn to the then secret Com Guards.  However during his military training those above him would have other plans.  His disdain for the House Lords and solid belief in the teachings of Blessed Blake quickly marked him for service within ROM.  He would disappear from the public eye for a long time, reappearing only occasionally and unwilling, or unable, to talk about what he was doing within the shadows for the Order.  With the stagnation of the Succession Wars broken he would fully return from the shadows, supposedly wishing for a transfer out the ranks of ROM.  Whether that is true, or simply part of something larger, only time will tell.
